text_block_list.text:
One evening, we're walking through the
shopping
district after a bit of shopping,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Look at that crowd over there, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's a wild wrestling match! If it is,
I want in!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It isn't. As we get closer...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
How about you there, with the mask?
Care to try
your luck?
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! I sure do! I really, really do! I
don't really
know how, though!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I explain how the raffle works. Basically,
you
spend a ticket for a chance to win a
prize.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I see! Well, it just happens that I
got a
raffle ticket earlier!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: This must be what it's for!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's do it together, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We've got one chance for a tag-team
attack!
What'll it be—bang or bust?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: En sus marcas, listos, fuera!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The two of us grasp the lever together
and turn
the raffle tumbler.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Qué?! A hot spring vacation coupon?!
Whoa...
this is a huge win!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Wait, they said it's a trip for two, right?
Does that
means I get to go with
somebody?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Nice! Use it however you'd like.

text_block_list.text: Bueno! Then, I'm gonna go with...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Grass, Grass, Grass! Grass and I are goin'
on a hot
spring vacation!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wait, no, no, no! I gotta think carefully...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, on second thought, maybe I
shouldn't
invite Grass...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Because I can already see it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Me, hyped as none other, splashing
around and
having a ball... And Grass
having none of it,
telling me to cut it
out!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Grass always gets mad at me whenever I
try to
play-wrestle in our room! Same
thing when I try
have a pillow fight!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Grass and I have way different
ideas of
what makes a good hot spring
vacation!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Grass is the calm kind of girl that
appreciates old
Japanese virtues.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Then, what are you gonna do?

text_block_list.text:
I'll have to find someone else. Someone
who
doesn't get angry when I'm having
fun...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Aha! Someone like you! Let's go
together,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If you go with me, you can pour as much
hot
spring water over your head as you
like, and eat
until you're ready to burst!
We can make
everything a competition!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
None of what she's saying sounds
relaxing, but
what worries me the most
is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Is it okay to go in the middle of the season?

text_block_list.text: Qué?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true. If I come home all
bloated from
scarfing down food with
you...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to soar at the track. I'll
be a rolling
condor...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's go once everything's
calmed down
after the Twinkle Series
and we have some time
on our hands!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yesss! All right, let's pinky promise!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm even more motivated now. From now
on, I'm
workin' toward my hot spring
vacation!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, first-prize! It may not be the
grand-prize,
but it's still pretty good!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's a deluxe carrot hamburger steak!
Plus, if you
leave the cooking to me,
you'll have no choice
but to enjoy it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make it just the way you like
it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Эль Кондор Паса is going to
cook it
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Welcome to El Restaurante de El.
And how
would you like that prepared?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
There's two you can pick from! Rare and
bloody!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We also have three sauces you can pick
from!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Green chili, mustard, and habanero!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It's a restaurant from hell.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Right?! This'll give us plenty of stamina
so we can
do our best for the rest of the
year!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, no grand-prize today! But all the
same, it's
a bountiful harvest—a sea of
carotene!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And if we use them well, we can do
some serious
training!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: What are you going to do with them all?

text_block_list.text:
First, I'm gonna totally line the edge of
my mask
with 'em!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Then, when I run at the training track,
Spe will
want some so bad she'll be
chasing after me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: All right, off I go! Chao!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I... don't see that happening. But when I
follow
after her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Look at all those carrots! Wait
up, El!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Laaame!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's... disappointing. I was hoping for

something more special...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's wager—you and I! Winner
takes all!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Rock, paper, scissors! If I win, you give
me the hot
spring coupon. ♪
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Y-ya know what? I think I'm gonna have
to pass...
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Nooooo! This is all I get after all my hard
work?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But guess what, Trainer! These aren't just
any
tissues!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
They belong to the world's strongest
racer, which
makes them the world's
strongest tissues! ♪
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ah, but even still, tissues are just tissues!
Dang!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The scene unfolds just like El Condor
Pasa
imagined. When she stops to eat,
we give a carrot
to Спешл Уик as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It just goes to show, hard work doesn't
guarantee
rewards. At least we have
something to blow our
noses with later.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса is quite pleased with her

nutritious prize.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her negotiations failed, Эль Кондор Паса
takes
home her single carrot.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I end up holding onto the hot spring
vacation
coupon. With one more goal to
work toward, El
Condor Pasa's morale
has gone up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
